visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two adult women sit on a beige sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room. Behind them are colorful pillows with cartoon rabbit and dog designs, and a framed abstract painting hangs on the wall to the left. The camera is static at an eye-level medium shot. (2) A third person, a young woman with short black hair, enters the frame from the right. She is wearing a bright yellow off-the-shoulder crop top and white denim shorts with a black belt, carrying a backpack. The woman in the maroon cardigan turns to look at her with an expression of shock, her mouth open and hand gesturing toward her. The young woman stands near the edge of the frame, looking down at her outfit. (3) The scene shifts to two adult men sitting on the same sofa. The man on the left has short black hair and wears a dark gray long-sleeved shirt; he is holding a blue book. The man on the right has short black hair and wears a yellow and black patterned sweater. They are engaged in a conversation, with the man on the right gesturing with his hands. The background remains the same living room setting with similar lighting and posters.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedy skit that satirizes parental hypocrisy and double standards. It shows parents praising modern fashion or progressive values in others while strictly forbidding the same behaviors or appearances for their own children.
